race_empire.name: Empire

race_high_elves.name: High Elves
race_high_elves.temper: Proud, patient and old; they measure time in moons and trust short-lived folk only after a deed.

bld_empire_blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
bld_empire_blacksmith.text: The smith fletches and arms an Archer every 30 turns.

bld_empire_library.name: Library
bld_empire_library.text: The chronicler keeps the Dimension's records here.

bld_empire_palace.name: Palace

bld_empire_quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
bld_empire_quartermaster.text: The quartermaster has supplies — and errands for strangers.

bld_empire_tower.name: Watchtower
bld_empire_tower.text: A stone watchtower of the Empire: whoever holds it holds the road.

bld_high_elves_dragon_shrine.name: Dragon Shrine
bld_high_elves_dragon_shrine.text: Wisps gather at the shrine; one wakes every 25 turns to help with the building.

bld_high_elves_dragonstone.name: Dragonstone
bld_high_elves_dragonstone.text: Old runes on the stone; the lorekeeper reads them to whoever listens.

bld_high_elves_merchant.name: Merchant
bld_high_elves_merchant.text: The merchant trades in favours: she has work for strangers.

bld_high_elves_shooting_range.name: Shooting Range
bld_high_elves_shooting_range.text: Longbows train here; a new one joins the watch every 20 turns while the village is below its cap.

bld_high_elves_tower.name: Elven Spire
bld_high_elves_tower.text: A slender spire of white stone; from its top the elves see the whole Dimension.

bld_high_elves_tower_of_the_moon.name: Tower of the Moon
bld_high_elves_tower_of_the_moon.text: The Iceguard keep vigil here; one is sent down every 30 turns.

logic.description: Angel of Mercy (caster) — stats V17/W20/M16/Wi16, Σ 69, life 7 = round(Σ/10). World (Souls, Time, Space) is its highest stat (20), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 20, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); Matter (Air, Water, Earth, Fire) is weakest (16) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 69 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 1 action(s) per round. dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_awe (elem_air + elem_harmony; permanent): "The target cannot deal damage to you until they visit their tower." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). logic.description: Etherium Abomination (caster) — stats V15/W10/M10/Wi20, Σ 55, life 6 = round(Σ/10). Will (Concentration, Harmony) is its highest stat (20), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 20, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); World (Souls, Time, Space) is weakest (10) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 55 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 2 action(s) per round. dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_fear (elem_air + elem_harmony; permanent): "The target character cannot do any damage until reaching their tower." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). Deck effects (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_deck_effects): its deck holds the 4 thematic effect cards Drain (effect_drain), Dark matter (effect_dark_matter), Disable (effect_disable), Combustion (effect_combustion) (data.deck_effects, picked by game/monster-deck.mjs pickThematicEffects: AI-castable, affordable for its stats under monster_effect_affordable, 2 damage + 1 defensive + the best remaining, scored by stats, tags, name and innate effect) plus data.monster_deck.random random playable effects fixed per monster instance (seed: map seed, peer label, creature id) — 11 actions + 4 skills + 6 effects = 21 cards. Once awake npcPlan casts the affordable ones on Posture / Empty Posture (game/monster-deck.mjs npcCastChoice: damage on an enemy in reach, defence with an enemy within 2, control on an enemy in contact), continues a cast without moving (Rule 19) and recycles an unusable effect card to its discard pile when no action card is left in hand. Summons keep the 15-card deck.

logic.description: Selftower Sphynx (control) — stats V15/W15/M15/Wi15, Σ 60, life 6 = round(Σ/10). Vitality (elem_vitality) is its highest stat (15), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 15, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); Vitality (elem_vitality) is weakest (15) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 60 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 3 action(s) per round. dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_domination (elem_souls + elem_harmony; permanent/channeling): "You control the target while you are in contact." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). Once awake npcPlan casts the affordable ones on Posture / Empty Posture (game/monster-deck.mjs npcCastChoice: damage on an enemy in reach, defence with an enemy within 2, control on an enemy in contact), continues a cast without moving (Rule 19) and recycles an unusable effect card to its discard pile when no action card is left in hand. logic.description: Tangle Spider 2B (caster) — stats V15/W20/M10/Wi20, Σ 65, life 4 on the card although round(Σ/10) = 7 (data contradiction, see validation life_matches_proposal_stats). World (Souls, Time, Space) is its highest stat (20), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 20, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); Matter (Air, Water, Earth, Fire) is weakest (10) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 65 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 3 action(s) per round. dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_creation (elem_earth; permanent/point_buy/channeling): "Place an impassable (for low-Matter creatures) adjacent wall token with power 20 × number of Creations cast. To destroy, enemy must emit Earth > wall/2× wall. + Put an Earth token on that tile." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). Deck effects (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_deck_effects): its deck holds the 4 thematic effect cards Drain (effect_drain), Space-bending (effect_space_bending), Disable (effect_disable), Aging (effect_aging) (data.deck_effects, picked by game/monster-deck.mjs pickThematicEffects: AI-castable, affordable for its stats under monster_effect_affordable, 2 damage + 1 defensive + the best remaining, scored by stats, tags, name and innate effect) plus data.monster_deck.random random playable effects fixed per monster instance (seed: map seed, peer label, creature id) — 11 actions + 4 skills + 6 effects = 21 cards. Once awake npcPlan casts the affordable ones on Posture / Empty Posture (game/monster-deck.mjs npcCastChoice: damage on an enemy in reach, defence with an enemy within 2, control on an enemy in contact), continues a cast without moving (Rule 19) and recycles an unusable effect card to its discard pile when no action card is left in hand. Summons keep the 15-card deck.

prerequisites.description: Rule 2/3: the creature acts only after its tile was attacked or moved towards (awakened).
Rule 3: it attacks only a character in contact (hex distance ≤ 1) — it never leaves its tile to chase.
effect_creation may go out: only Posture / Empty Posture emit elements (Rule 20) and none of its elements is Disabled for the monster.

What a Summoning / Resurrect must bank to take this creature: its stat sum.
Actions the monster plays each round (Rule 1).
D6 thrown per action: the pattern length, or 4 for the default BMAP set (Rule 5).
Number of Attack (red) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
Number of Block (green) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
Number of Move (blue/white) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
Number of Posture (black) faces among the dice thrown (default BMAP); a literal because JsonLogic cannot count letters in a string.
No on-action rider — always 0.
Resolution-matrix damage of the monster's revealed action against the defender's (1 for Attack, +1 on a winning edge, Attack vs Posture = 2).
Rule 21: damage a completed cast by `caster` with `elements` does to this creature with its canonical stats (its high stat shrugs those elements off).
Rule 3: with no enemy in contact the monster regenerates to full — life restored this turn; 0 while engaged.
Effect cards in a monster deck of this creature: its deck_effects plus the random ones (rule_monster_deck_effects data.monster_deck.random).

validation.description: Each of the four stats may move at most ±5 from the canonical value.
life equals round_half_up(Σ proposal stats / 10).
actions_per_round stays 1..4 and is not changed by a rebalance.
dice_pattern is null (default BMAP) or 3–6 face letters out of A B M P.
innate_effect is null or the id of an existing effect (catalog lookup of its element_cost).
on_action_rider is null or { action ∈ action codes, bonus_damage 1..3 }.
deck_effects is absent or exactly data.monster_deck.thematic distinct effect ids (monster_deck_effects_valid).
Every deck effect exists and is affordable for the proposal stats (monster_effect_affordable over the stat behind each element; delta = a damage effect without point_buy).
